name: onesixtyone
summary: An SNMP scanner that sends multiple SNMP requests to multiple IP addresses
highlights: -p — specify an alternate destination SNMP port
-d — debug mode, use twice for more information
-s — short mode, only print IP addresses
-w — wait n milliseconds (1/1000 of a second) between sending packets (default 10)
-q — quiet mode, do not print log to stdout, use with -o
